title: Deactivating or reactivating a term sends nothing to QuickBooks
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop is connected to QuickBooks and switches off, then back on, a term QuickBooks already has.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The test organization is connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company, and you can sign in to that company in another tab.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A} is already in QuickBooks (an invoice used it).
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S8-07 Used.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
  3. In QuickBooks, open the Terms list (Settings, All lists, Terms).
  4. On the Inactive tab, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  5. Click "Reactivate".
  6. In QuickBooks, refresh the Terms list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the toast "{Term-A} deactivated" shows.
  • Step 3: {Term-A} is still there, unchanged (active in QuickBooks).
  • Step 4: the menu opens.
  • Step 5: the term is active again.
  • Step 6: {Term-A} is unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11677 (Story 8, QuickBooks sync - credit terms)
